verdict.rationale: The H200 ships within NVIDIA's software ecosystem (CUDA Toolkit, NIM, developer portal), so asking for an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. The pack has no evidence of one with runnable examples: the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Brev Launchables and build.nvidia.com inference endpoints are adjacent environments or services, not an interactive API reference for this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
